selectionRule.global: Select the single policy with maximum training net / training trades across all 48 groups, minimum 100 training trades in each symbol; tie-break lower policy index. Research alternatives are equally weighted; this is not a portfolio.
selectionRule.validation: After fixing the training winner, require at least 30 holdout trades, positive holdout net, and holdout CTS cost-PF > 1.02 separately in BCH, SOL and XRP. Do not reselect using holdout.
selectionRule.lane: Existing runner selects max training net per symbol / indication / direction, minimum 8 training closes. Holdout requires 8 closes, positive net and CTS cost-PF > 1.02 separately.
